task: Author request: review Codex's PRs #111 (S1) and #112 (S2), make corrections, then build the test package recognised as v0.3.70; do not merge
author: Claude

review.#111 S1: agreed with. Touch of Chaos keeps the worse of two dice (ModifyD20), credited as 1 - pass on the first attack; Song of Discord redirect credited only when the nearest unit is the enemy's ally; marks use the cached routine of the same target and frame; Contagion ticks at Frequency.ToRounds; Unholy Nimbus withheld with a witness reason.
#111 S1 limits kept: a mark scores 0 when its target is out of reach or no routine was read this frame
a smite's AC part is not in the mark gain
review.#112 S2: native reading agreed with: AbilityCustomDimensionDoor.Deliver offset (both bodies + MinWeaponRange in target facing), GetTargets travellers, AddMounts, FreePlaceSelector.RelaxPoints(points, radii, count, rootPoint = null); AbilityCustomTeleportation same offset, caster alone, RelaxPoints false. Landing price matches the Griffon leap.

corrections: AddTeleportApproach had no caller: teleports were collected and dropped, and no longer reached ordinary scoring, so the S2 package never used them in either mode. Decide now calls it after RepriceRealPaths, not in a preview.
A teleport aimed at an enemy is no longer watched by CastOutcome for an effect on that enemy (each Vrock cast logged 'did nothing to its target'; blockOnNoReach was already off).

[Unused] reasons per teleport: no legal aim, combat policy, no gain, past the four-aim budget, or TeleportWithheld (item, cost, mount, held charge, crowd), in place of 'no verified safe teleport landing'.
Merge: the S1/S2 reasons DelayedDelivery and TeleportLanding move into UnusedState beside Scored; the consumables review is section 220, S1/S2 stay 218/219.
